_meta.notes: BUNDLE: page 1 is the handwritten 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign Committee' notice (committee 'Committee to Elect Hawkins', office 'SALT LAKE COUNTY AUDITOR', signed 9/15/2014, clerk stamp OCT 21 2014); page 2 is blank (faint bleed-through only); pages 3-4 are the attached final summary - a machine-printed slco.org electronic 'Financial Disclosure Report' with a 'Summary' table, NOT the handwritten Summary Page form. That electronic table has FOUR money columns (Total this Period / YTD / Total this Period Other Campaign Accounts / YTD Other Campaign Accounts); Column A is mapped from 'Total this Period' and Column B from 'YTD'. Both 'Other Campaign Accounts' columns print $0.00 on lines 1 and 2 and are not captured. The form prints 'Report: Interim Report' even though the bundle is a dissolution - the FORM FACE is recorded.
